content: {"reasoning":"The prior CO-197 denial has already been appealed, and no new payer response is available to support another appeal or information submission. Retroactive authorization is outside the 30-day window, peer-to-peer review is unavailable, and no claim-data error supports resubmission. The authorization denial does not establish patient liability, and writing off the balance before the appeal outcome would be premature; a specialist must investigate the appeal status because no available automated action can properly progress the claim.","action":"escalate"}
